info: Reduced soft-sprite black flashes during HGR present (e.g. Galaxian invaders) with a one-/two-present erase-hold on HGR bytes, without freezing the whole frame on a VRAM-quiet wait.<context="release info"/>
Stopped forced mid-play HGR refreshes on the RLCD 4.2 path that reintroduced tear samples; text mode still gets an occasional refresh for cursor/ROM updates.<context="release info"/>

Added Waveshare/Luckfox ESP32-S3-RLCD-4.2 as an ESP][ target (ST7305 mono): PlatformIO envs rlcd42_bringup / rlcd42_display_probe / rlcd42_apple2, SDMMC 1-bit SD, KEY/BOOT Control Center (PHYSICALLY_VERIFIED Galaxian boot path).<context="release info"/>
RLCD classic present defaults to sharp integer 1× (280×192 with letterbox); optional full-panel fit remains available in the Display menu.<context="release info"/>
Sped up RLCD frame output with batched ST7305 SPI transfers and a one-pass mono pack (drawPixel flush was the previous bottleneck).<context="release info"/>
Shipped on-device Control Center as a frontend over existing presentation, Disk II, BLE HID, and SD-ownership services (touch on AMOLED; buttons on RLCD).<context="release info"/>
Expanded multi-board Project Control: diymore ES3C28P and RLCD 4.2 platform IDs alongside the Waveshare AMOLED production baseline.<context="release info"/>

Galaxian runs on physical ESP][ hardware (PHYSICALLY_VERIFIED): Apple II+ ROM, Disk II Autostart, NMOS 6502, HGR playfield on the CO5300 AMOLED — not a native port or screenshot overlay.<context="release info"/>
Physical presentation modes: Classic (default) and optional Landscape; HGR Sharp and Artifact Color via shared ArtifactRenderer (emulation ≈1.023 MHz).<context="release info"/>
Windows CDC keyboard bridge physically verified for Galaxian cracktro→A→second disk load; 8BitDo gameplay NOT_TESTED; physical audio NOT_TESTED.<context="release info"/>
Landscape presentation preserves full 280×192 with edge-preserving nearest-neighbor scale after CW 90° (SCORE/HISCORE edges retained).<context="release info"/>
Disk II accuracy: physical Address Field sector mapping and half-track stepper distance corrected (generic fixes; not Galaxian-specific hacks).<context="release info"/>
Keyboard print reference: parametric Brown one-piece carrier + white 0.2 mm-nozzle legend architecture and separate POWER indicator (DOCUMENTED / PROVISIONAL absolute scale).<context="release info"/>
Introduced RELEASES.json with µGulp release-history workflow (en-US source, 30-day contributor merge, release-info context tags).<context="release info"/>

Added Green and Amber phosphor monitor appearances plus an optional lightweight CRT/TV display effect, composed independently from Classic/Landscape orientation and Artifact Color.<context="release info"/>

Verified Little Brick Out as a second real-software title on the physical ESP][: LORES+MIXED playfield on the CO5300, with the Windows USB/CDC multi-input bridge ready for Logitech Dial as Apple II paddle 0.<context="release info"/>
Added verified ESP][ SD backup and restore for card migration and recovery.<context="release info"/>

Fixed a long-run Apple II throttle stall caused by the 32-bit microsecond timer wrapping after about 71.6 minutes; Galaxian now passes a 2-hour physical soak test (PHYSICALLY_VERIFIED).<context="release info"/>
Windows CDC input bridge and serial media tooling for physical software bring-up (PHYSICALLY_VERIFIED path for keyboard latch injection).<context="release info"/>
microSD remount on SPI3 and hardened Disk II boot path for Waveshare AMOLED board (PHYSICALLY_VERIFIED mount/boot diagnostics).<context="release info"/>
User-supplied Apple II+ ROM runs interactively on ESP32-S3 with Level-4 Disk II spot checks (PHYSICALLY_VERIFIED ROM startup / HOST_VERIFIED emulator suite).<context="release info"/>
Mechanical reference assembly and enclosure specification foundation for Plasticity-ready CAD (DOCUMENTED; enclosure design not complete).<context="release info"/>
NAS backup policy: valuable gitignored local/reference assets backed independently of Git eligibility (DOCUMENTED).<context="release info"/>
ESP][ project foundation: PlatformIO bring-up, µGulp task catalog, CLAUDE.md engineering standards.<context="release info"/>
